entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: The live PDS product label identifies urn:nasa:pds:gbo.ast-apophis.jpl.radar.shape_model:data:apophis_v233s7_obj version 1.0 as Model B of Brozović 2018. It describes 2000 vertices, kilometer coordinates and longitude zero along the long positive X principal axis. Its 2025 file creation and 2026 archive publication are not new radar observations or a newer physical solution. The retained original mesh and spin labels support the selected shape; optical imagery remains unqualified.
